Fact: integration_means
What to find: Technical means for integrating the model (usage instructions, APIs, serving frameworks, prompt/chat format).
Card sections that often contain it: How to Use, Quickstart, Usage, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Usable via Hugging Face transformers (v4.51.0 or later) with AutoProcessor and Llama4ForConditionalGeneration. The card gives a code example that uses processor.apply_chat_template with chat messages that mix image and text content. On-the-fly int4 quantization code is also provided.
quotes: Please, make sure you have transformers v4.51.0 installed, or upgrade using pip install -U transformers.
We provide code for on-the-fly int4 quantization which minimizes performance degradation as well.
